summary:
ASTRA: Earth's Mission Architect is a cinematic, interactive educational space-mission design game developed by QUADFORGE.

Set in a fictional 2035 asteroid scenario, ASTRA allows players to experience the journey of designing and executing a planetary-defence mission.

Players investigate an asteroid, define scientific objectives, design spacecraft, plan orbital trajectories, manage engineering constraints, and test a kinetic-impact mission.

The game combines space science, systems engineering, interactive simulations, and cinematic storytelling to make complex space-mission concepts accessible and engaging.

ASTRA is designed for PC, tablets, and mobile devices, with keyboard, mouse, and touch controls, adjustable graphics, and accessibility options.

Our goal is to inspire learners to explore space science and understand how scientific missions are designed and developed.
details:
ASTRA is a browser-based, single-file HTML educational game that simulates the complete process of designing and executing a fictional planetary-defence mission.

The experience is organized into five interactive chapters:

CHAPTER 1 – THE DISCOVERY
Players investigate a fictional asteroid, explore its characteristics, and define the primary scientific objectives of the mission.

CHAPTER 2 – THE ARCHITECT
Players design a spacecraft by selecting components and balancing mass, power, cost, and reliability. The chapter introduces a simplified Concept Maturity Level progression from CML 1 to CML 4.

CHAPTER 3 – THE NAVIGATOR
Players select launch windows, explore orbital transfer trajectories, and evaluate launcher and propellant requirements through interactive orbital visualization.

CHAPTER 4 – THE INTERCEPTION
Players monitor spacecraft health, respond to in-flight anomalies, observe the asteroid, and configure a kinetic-impact experiment.

CHAPTER 5 – HUMANITY'S FUTURE
Players analyse mission outcomes, evaluate performance, review scientific results, and understand the limitations of their mission design.

KEY FEATURES:

• Five interactive mission chapters.
• Interactive spacecraft engineering and component selection.
• Orbital trajectory visualization and launch planning.
• Simplified planetary-defence and kinetic-impact simulation.
• Mission performance evaluation and scoring.
• PC, tablet, and mobile-friendly responsive interface.
• Keyboard, mouse, and touch controls.
• Adjustable graphics quality and automatic performance settings.
• Accessibility features, including subtitles, high contrast, reduced motion, and adjustable text size.
• Cinematic introduction, narration, original soundtrack, and sound effects.
• Educational activities and a space-science glossary.

TECHNOLOGY:

ASTRA is developed using HTML, CSS, and JavaScript as a self-contained application that runs in a modern web browser.

SCIENTIFIC LIMITATIONS:

ASTRA uses a simplified two-dimensional Sun-only two-body orbital model with a Lambert solver. Its asteroid scenario, engineering values, and mission results are illustrative and fictional. The simulation is designed for education and is not intended for real spacecraft navigation or operational planetary-defence decisions.
